description: This file is a Perl module named 'testutil' containing miscellaneous utility functions used within the curl test suite. It provides functions for logging, file inclusion, base64 and hex encoding/decoding, newline manipulation, and running external commands.

methods.name: logmsg
methods.description: Logs an informational message, either via a callback function or buffers it for later retrieval.

methods.name: setlogfunc
methods.description: Sets the callback function used for logging messages.

methods.name: clearlogs
methods.description: Clears buffered log messages and returns them as a single string.

methods.name: includefile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file and returns it as a string.

methods.name: subbase64
methods.description: Performs in-place base64 and hex encoding/decoding on a variable text containing specific markers.

methods.name: subnewlines
methods.description: Normalizes newline characters within a string, optionally forcing CRLF line endings.

methods.name: runclient
methods.description: Executes a command and returns its exit status.

methods.name: runclientoutput
methods.description: Executes a command and returns its standard output.

methods.name: shell_quote
methods.description: Quotes a string safely for passing as a shell argument.
